content: Cloudflare Web Analytics is cookieless by default (no device storage), so ePrivacy cookie-consent rules don't apply; GDPR privacy-policy disclosure of IP/user-agent processing is still advisable. Plausible/Umami are comparable cookieless options; Cloudflare Web Analytics is the simplest choice when already on Cloudflare Pages (zero extra infra, free, single script-tag or dashboard toggle).
